integrity: The analytic statements are proved by a rank-one quadratic-form compression and the classical beta distribution of Haar subspace projections; numerical checks only corroborate finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Valid only for centered Euclidean one-spike ellipsoids, N>=2, 1<=n<N and a>b>0. No multiple-spike joint spectral law, general ellipsoid random-radius theorem or universal improved concentration bound is asserted.
title: Exact random-radius law for one-spike ellipsoids in every codimension
